Apple today released the first iOS 27.2 beta, a move that comes as a surprise since no 27.1 version has ever been released before. In addition to a completely new Health app, iOS 27.2 beta 1 also expands Siri AI support to five new languages.

iOS 27.2 beta 1 adds French, Japanese, Spanish and more language support for Siri AI

When Siri AI launched earlier this week alongside iOS 27, it was only available to users who had set their device language to English.

However, Apple promised at the time that more languages would be supported soon, and if you're currently running the developer version, the wait has indeed been very short.

iOS 27.2 beta 1 debuts today with Siri AI support for the following newly added languages:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

Considering that the version released this week only supported English, this can be described as a major expansion.

However, now as long as you're running the iOS 27.2 developer version, even if you set your device to English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese or Spanish, you can use the more powerful Siri AI features.

Have you tried Siri AI in iOS 27 yet? How does it feel to use? Feel free to tell us in the comments section.
